standard.summary: 保留字段。通用 optimizer wrapper 当前拿不到舍入前的 FP32 参数更新，因此启用会 fail-fast，不宣称已实现标准无偏随机舍入。
standard.effect: 只有优化器持有 pre-cast FP32 update source 时才能做无偏随机舍入；对已经是 BF16/FP16 的参数再次舍入无法恢复已丢失的小数部分。
standard.whenToUse: 仅使用明确拥有 FP32 update source 的优化器内建实现，例如 Rose 的内部更新路径。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要启用通用 stochastic_rounding wrapper；当前会返回 STOCHASTIC_ROUNDING_WRAPPER_UNWIRED。

standard_en.summary: A reserved field. The general optimizer wrapper currently has no access to the pre-rounding FP32 parameter update, so enabling this fails fast; it does not claim to implement standard unbiased stochastic rounding.
standard_en.effect: Unbiased stochastic rounding is only possible when the optimizer holds the pre-cast FP32 update source; rounding a parameter that is already BF16/FP16 a second time cannot recover the fractional part that was already lost.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only use an optimizer's own built-in implementation where it clearly owns an FP32 update source, such as Rose's internal update path.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable the general stochastic_rounding wrapper; it currently returns STOCHASTIC_ROUNDING_WRAPPER_UNWIRED.

advanced.principle: 标准随机舍入需要精确值 x 与目标 dtype 的上下相邻可表示值。若输入本身已经是 BF16/FP16，x 的残差已经丢失，任何后处理都不能证明无偏。
advanced.intervention: 通用 wrapper 保持 reserve/fail-fast；source-aware helper 仅接受显式 source_fp32。
advanced.expectedImpact: 当前通用路径无质量收益声明；需要先完成 optimizer-owned FP32 update contract。
advanced.tradeoffs: 启用旧通用开关会在 optimizer setup 阶段明确拒绝。
advanced.codePath: stochastic_rounding.py: stochastic_round_(..., source_fp32=...)；Rose 使用独立 FP32 update source

advanced_en.principle: Standard stochastic rounding requires the exact value x and the adjacent representable values of the target dtype. If the input is already BF16/FP16, x's residual is lost, and no post-processing can prove unbiasedness.
advanced_en.intervention: The generic wrapper keeps reserve/fail-fast; the source-aware helper only accepts explicit source_fp32.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The current generic path claims no quality benefit; the optimizer-owned FP32 update contract must land first.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Enabling the old generic switch is explicitly rejected at optimizer setup.
advanced_en.codePath: stochastic_rounding.py: stochastic_round_(..., source_fp32=...); Rose uses an independent FP32 update source
